content:
This is going to need a lot more cases for reverse. Even for fastest mode, you don't actually say how to find Saras. The two places in which she is rumoured to hide she does not appear.

"Input Example:", "Output Example:" and "Additional Info:" can be removed from the statement.
The input and output sections should contain a description of the input/output lines and their contained information. e.g. (for input):  <<1 Line:>> A string of 1 or more words representing the [[place]] to check.

Goal:
- format "Saras" and "sage" as {{}} constants. Reference this page for formatting syntax: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement#guidelines

Constraints:
 - "Saras could only be in one place at a time" seems to refer to the fact that there is only one case pair in which she is found. There should be more case pairs like this and so the constraint should be removed.
 - "Places with no Saras need to be sage for protection" is not a constraint

Solution:
 -Rewrite the solution so that it follows the rules as given to the player, rather than a hardcoded solution.
